checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a point in a V-shape, distinct from the U-shape of an alligator. The profile is consistent with a crocodilian.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple sharp, conical teeth are clearly visible along the jawline. The fourth tooth on the lower jaw appears prominent, fitting the interlocking description.
